title: EventLog
description: Log of user operations via CLI or Web UI.

event.description: A key describing the type of event.

execution_date.description: When the event was dispatched for an object having execution_date, the value of this field.

extra.description: Other information that was not included in the other fields, e.g. the complete CLI command.

owner.description: Name of the user who triggered these events a.

when.description: The time when these events happened.
